summary: Frontend-only verification completed on public preview URL for /demo (Variant A), /demopages (Variant B), /investor 4-step onboarding, reduced-motion behavior, responsive breakpoints, query-state updates, launch routing, no-API investor flow, and core route regressions. Two customer onboarding issues found: keyboard-inaccessible searchable picker selection and mobile picker popover clipping.

ui_bugs.issue: Keyboard selection in searchable picker fails (ArrowDown+Enter and Tab+Enter do not select options), so keyboard users cannot complete context to 4/4 reliably.
At 390x844, team picker popover renders below viewport (bottom clipped), reducing discoverability/access to options.
Interactive close button in picker menu does not have data-testid, violating full testability requirement for interactive elements.

issues: Picker overlay vertical fit issue causes clipped list area when opened near lower viewport region.

action_items: Implement true keyboard-combobox behavior in SearchPicker (roving/highlighted option + Enter selection + Escape close) and verify query param updates via keyboard-only flow.
Fix mobile picker positioning (flip/drop-up or viewport-aware anchoring + max-height clamp) to prevent clipping at 390x844.
Add unique data-testid to picker close button and any remaining new interactive controls without test ids.
Re-test /demo and /demopages keyboard-only completion path and mobile popover behavior after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: Root cause (keyboard bug): SearchPicker handles only click-based option selection; no keydown handler exists to convert search input navigation/confirmation into option selection.
Root cause (clipping): .canvas-picker-menu uses fixed top offset and max-height without viewport-aware placement, causing overflow beyond viewport bottom on small screens.
Variant A and Variant B shared canvas structure is correctly reused after Variant B problem submit (same core data-testid structure present).
Investor flow implementation matches requested 4-step + tailored brief pattern, including respectful skip/prefer-not-to-say options and no onboarding API/CRM requests observed during run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated passing flows: Variant A simultaneous canvas, pointer-driven query updates, 4/4 state -> READY, mini-laptop open, launch to /demo/customer/:role/:department/:industry with params, Variant B problem-first morph with retained problem, investor 4-step brief and exploring->venture mapping, no horizontal overflow at 1920x800/768x1024/390x844, and reduced-motion progression. Remaining failures are keyboard selection in searchable picker and mobile popover clipping.
rca of the issue: Reproduction (keyboard): /demo -> fill problem -> select role via keyboard -> open Team picker -> type 'Finance' -> ArrowDown+Enter (or Tab+Enter). Expected: department query set and signal count increments. Actual: no selection, URL remains without department, launch stays incomplete. Reproduction (mobile clipping): /demopages -> complete problem stage -> set viewport 390x844 -> open Team picker. Expected: full options list visible within viewport. Actual: menu bottom extends beyond viewport. Mitigation: implement ARIA-compliant combobox keyboard handling and viewport-aware popover placement (flip or constrained height with internal scroll and safe inset).
